title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：weapon　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 weapon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the clerk ① hid the weapon that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the hiding was the whole of the month. The ② weapon, meaning the arm itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a weapon, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ weapon in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ weapon at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A weapon, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the weapon was the whole of the matter, meaning the threat and not the arm. The ⑥ weapon, meaning the threat and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; weapon, he said, is either something you hide or the only word that means both an arm and a threat. He said the threat is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ weapon had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ weapon of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; weapon, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ weapon I remember is the arm recorded in the file, which closed in 1967 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ weapon, my mother said in 1969, is the only arm that improves by being recorded; every weapon, she said, is a threat that has agreed to look like an arm. She said the threat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 武器（指办事处里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 武器（指那件武器本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：hide the weapon 藏这一件武器
D. n. 武器（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 武器之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的武器之事）
F. n. 武器（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一件）
G. n. 武器、凶险（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 凶险（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: hid the weapon that no applicant in the office would have recorded

the weapon at the far counter

answers.why: hide the weapon 意为“藏这一件武器”，1960 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一件武器做了一遍。
weapon 意为“武器”，指那件武器本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
weapon 意为“武器”，指办事处里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
weapon 意为“武器”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
weapon 意为“武器、凶险”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这件凶险就是那件事的全部。
weapon 意为“凶险”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件武器，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
weapon 意为“武器”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一件，到 1965 年这一件成了卷宗里的一行。
weapon 意为“武器之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的武器之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
weapon 意为“武器”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一件，1967 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一件。
weapon 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，武器是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的武器。
